top_concerns: Novelty is limited: it combines LLM-generated code with LLM action masking, and the goal function relies on hand-supplied Crafter tech-tree knowledge, so LLM prior is not separated from human engineering.

Baselines are weak or unfairly constrained: ELLM and AdaRefiner are queried only every 200 steps, Crafter numbers are copied from other papers, and there is no PPO + same mask or hand-written heuristic control and no strong non-LLM baselines.
Gains are modest (33.8 vs 28.5 score, reward about equal) with 5 seeds and no significance tests. The ablation uses 10M steps while baselines stop at 5M.
Efficiency claims lack data: total LLM cost, calls and tokens are not reported, SPS is 7x below PPO, and there is no variance across LLM-generated goal functions.
Method inconsistencies (Eq. 3-5 annealing fully relaxes the mask by 0.8T, the logit masking form, Figure 5 labelled Crafter vs Craftax-Classic) and evaluation on a single environment family only.
